description: Search indexed employers. Headquarters and active_jobs do not prove Swiss vacancies. Use search_jobs to find Swiss positions.

country.description: Headquarters country code, e.g. CH. This is not job location.

has_jobs.description: Filter on canonical active job count; not restricted to Swiss or fresh sources.

offset.description: Use next_offset from the previous response; maximum 5000.

sector.description: Sector contains this text. Maximum 40 UTF-8 bytes.

swiss_jobs.description: When true, only employers with a recorded domain and active Swiss-eligible jobs from enabled sources. Does not imply source freshness.

name: search_companies
title: Find employers
